title: Sauli and Riario (Portugal) to the papal Secretariat, 1579-81 (ASV Segr. Stato Portogallo 8, DECODE R190-R194)

steps.what: DECODE R190-R194 metadata, 22 page images and DOC attachments fetched with the session cookie; Lasry's key and his R190-R191 decryption found on the records.
Web search for an edition of Riario's legation letters; none found.
Lasry's reconstructed key coded as decrypt.py.
Cipher passages of R192-R194 (11 pp.) transcribed as digits by two image agents, with the interlinear glosses and page summaries.
Each decrypt compared with the contemporary gloss: agreement wherever legible; only one short tail on R192 p.1 lacks a gloss.
Code words added to the key from gloss alignment: 16 Inghilterra, 30 S.S.ta, 36 Francia, 40 cattolici, 10 Italia(?).

outcome.method_basis: Nearly every cipher passage in Portogallo 8 carries the secretariat's contemporary interlinear decipherment; the passages were transcribed and each decrypted with Lasry's key (DECODE, Oct 2020) only to check the gloss, with which it agreed wherever legible.
outcome.notes: Read from the contemporary decipherments, checked with the key; a few code groups (20/28, 72/82, 4-digit prefixes, one tail) open.

prior.where: Contemporary interlinear decipherments on the letters; Lasry's reconstructed key and R190-R191 decryption on DECODE (Oct 2020)

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie to the model, set up Claude Code, and posed the problem with /goal. No target-specific intervention recorded.
